benchmark_model_throughput: benchmark a PyTorch model to measure images per second throughput on a given device
benchmark_model_fp16: benchmark a PyTorch model with float16 autocast enabled for faster inference measurement
benchmark_model_custom_batch: benchmark a PyTorch model with a custom batch size and input resolution
parse_r_constant: parse a constant integer r value into a per-layer token reduction schedule list
parse_r_schedule: parse an r and inflection tuple into a per-layer token reduction schedule with upward or downward trend
